k:五.mnemonic: A five-bar gate seen from the side, squashed into a box shape. Five.

k:語.mnemonic: Say (言) five (五) things with your mouth (口), and you are speaking a language. Language.

k:初.mnemonic: A cloak (衤) and a sword (刀). The first thing a tailor does is cut the cloth with a blade. First (beginning).

k:南.mnemonic: A flat (平) plant with a ten (十) on top, growing inside a hood (冂): a greenhouse that faces south for the sun. South.

k:工.mnemonic: An I-beam seen end-on, or a carpenter's square. Construction (craft, work).

k:穴.mnemonic: A roof (宀) over a pair of fins: a cave entrance. Hole.

k:空.mnemonic: A hole (穴) in the construction (工). Look up through the hole in the roof and you see the empty sky. Sky (empty).
k:空.hint: Hole in the roof shows the sky.

k:原.mnemonic: Under an overhang (厂), a small (小) white (白) spring bubbles up: the original source of the river. Original (meadow).

k:持.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) at the temple (寺). You hold the offering with your fingers. Hold.

k:放.mnemonic: Strike (攵) the signpost pointing the direction (方) and let go of everything. Release (set free).

k:信.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who says (言) something. You believe what your leader says. Believe (trust).

k:和.mnemonic: Grain (禾) next to a mouth (口). When every mouth has grain there is harmony. Harmony (Japan, peace).

k:性.mnemonic: A heartbeat (忄) and life (生). What the heart is born with: gender, nature. Gender (nature).
k:性.hint: The heart you are born with.

k:去.mnemonic: Soil (土) over a cocoon (厶). The cocoon is buried in the soil and the butterfly is gone. Gone (leave, past).

k:法.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) is gone (去). To make the water go away you need a method: a law of engineering. Method (law).
k:法.hint: A method to make the water go.

k:読.mnemonic: To sell (売) with words (言) you first have to read the contract. Read.

k:式.mnemonic: A peg (弋) and construction (工). Pegging out the ground for a building is done with a formal ceremony. Ceremony (style, formula).

k:最.mnemonic: Take (取) the dawn (旦): whoever grabs the first light gets the most. Most.

k:糸.mnemonic: A twisted strand with three loose ends at the bottom. Thread.

k:経.mnemonic: Thread (糸), a hand (又) and soil (土). Threads laid across the soil by hand are lines of longitude. Longitude (pass through, manage).

k:夫.mnemonic: A big (大) person (人) with a hairpin through their hair: a grown man, a husband. Husband.

k:勝.mnemonic: The moon (月), horns (丷), a husband (夫) and power (力). Under the moon the horned husband uses all his power to win. Win (victory).

k:曲.mnemonic: A sun (日) with a stick (｜) poked through it, bent out of shape. Bend (music: a tune bends).

k:申.mnemonic: A rice field (田) with a stick through the middle, bent (曲) at the ends: a monkey hanging off a pole in the field. Monkey (say humbly).

k:神.mnemonic: An altar (礻) with a monkey (申) on it. The monkey the villagers worship at the altar is a god. God (spirit).
